list.name: AssessmentRunId
list.query: select distinct AssessmentRunId from EnterpriseScoreAssessment order by AssessmentRunId desc

list.name: LoadId
list.query: select distinct LoadId from TestLoad order by LoadId desc

panels.title: Como leer este dashboard
panels.description: Explica como leer los indicadores enterprise y como tratar evidencia faltante.

options.content: Que muestra: salud tecnologica enterprise, scores, evidencia y riesgos. Como interpretarlo: SIN EVIDENCIA no es OK. Accion sugerida: priorizar riesgos criticos y evidencia faltante.

panels.title: Technology Health Score
panels.description: Score consolidado 0-100 de salud tecnologica; combina capacidad, performance, disponibilidad, ciclo de vida, compliance y confianza de monitoreo.

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(round(avg(ScoreValue),2),0) as TechnologyHealthScore from EnterpriseScoreAssessment where ScoreType = 'TechnologyHealth' and AssessmentRunId ~ '^(${AssessmentRunId:regex})'

panels.title: Capacity Score
panels.description: Score promedio de capacidad para el alcance seleccionado; valores bajos indican riesgo de saturacion o headroom insuficiente.

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(round(avg(ScoreValue),2),0) as CapacityScore from EnterpriseScoreAssessment where ScoreType = 'Capacity' and AssessmentRunId ~ '^(${AssessmentRunId:regex})'

panels.title: Monitoring Confidence
panels.description: Nivel de confianza de monitoreo segun frescura, completitud y verificacion de evidencia.

targets.rawSql: select coalesce(round(avg(ScoreValue),2),0) as MonitoringConfidence from EnterpriseScoreAssessment where ScoreType = 'MonitoringConfidence' and AssessmentRunId ~ '^(${AssessmentRunId:regex})'

panels.title: SIN EVIDENCIA
panels.description: Cantidad de evidencias faltantes, desconocidas, incompletas o no verificadas; no deben interpretarse como estado saludable.

targets.rawSql: select count(*) as SinEvidencia from EnterpriseEvidenceRecord where EvidenceState in ('Missing','Unknown','Incomplete','Unverified') and LoadId ~ '^(${LoadId:regex})'

panels.title: Risk Heat Map
panels.description: Distribucion de riesgos por dominio tecnologico y severidad para priorizacion ejecutiva.

targets.rawSql: select c.DomainName, r.Severity, count(*) as RiskCount from EnterpriseRiskRegistryEntry r join EnterpriseTechnologyComponent c on c.ComponentId = r.AffectedTechnologyId where r.LoadId ~ '^(${LoadId:regex})' group by c.DomainName, r.Severity order by c.DomainName, r.Severity

panels.title: Top 10 Riesgos
panels.description: Principales riesgos con tecnologia afectada, servicio, impacto, accion recomendada y estado de evidencia.

targets.rawSql: select r.Severity, c.ComponentName as TecnologiaAfectada, s.Name as ServicioAfectado, r.Impact, r.RecommendedAction, r.EvidenceState from EnterpriseRiskRegistryEntry r left join EnterpriseTechnologyComponent c on c.ComponentId = r.AffectedTechnologyId left join Service s on s.ServiceId = r.AffectedServiceId where r.LoadId ~ '^(${LoadId:regex})' order by case r.Severity when 'Critical' then 4 when 'High' then 3 when 'Medium' then 2 else 1 end desc limit 10

panels.title: Executive Decision Summary
panels.description: Resumen de decisiones recomendadas, racional y responsable sugerido para seguimiento ejecutivo.

targets.rawSql: select rec.Priority, rec.Action, rec.Rationale, rec.DecisionOwner, r.EvidenceState from EnterpriseRecommendation rec join EnterpriseRiskRegistryEntry r on r.RiskId = rec.RiskId where rec.LoadId ~ '^(${LoadId:regex})' order by case rec.Priority when 'Critical' then 4 when 'High' then 3 when 'Medium' then 2 else 1 end desc limit 20
